title.quote: European Ethical Charter on the use of artificial intelligence in judicial systems and their environment (2019)

date_published.quote: has adopted on 4th December 2018 the first European text setting out ethical principles

issuing_body.quote: The European Commission for the Efficiency of Justice (Cepej) of the Council of Europe has adopted

status.quote: the first European text setting out ethical principles relating to the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in judicial systems

judgment.status_reasoning: A non-binding charter adopted in 2018; nothing stored shows it withdrawn or replaced, so status stays Published (non-binding, current). The official rm.coe.int PDF is not stored; secondary_url is a full copy of the charter text, so no URL change is proposed.
